goal: Diseña la primera ola de trabajo para FA-MA
objective: Review the packet wave outputs, identify collisions, missing validations, and integration risks.
scope_summary: Cross-packet review. Uses packet outputs and manifests rather than raw repo surfaces.
acceptance_gates: Call out overlaps or collisions across packet scopes.
Name missing tests, missing docs, and risky assumptions.
constraints: Do not dump whole large files; summarize and cite targeted slices.
Prefer small, composable changes that can be merged independently.
Respect repo conventions and monorepo entrypoint reality.
Output must be useful even if the next packet runs on a smaller model.
risk_notes: Do not re-implement code here; synthesize and challenge.
